about: The same restructuring task on the same pinned commits: a generic coding agent (G3: opencode 1.18.34 with NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Nebius Token Factory, a fixed prompt, no human input) and architecture-cleaner. Every typed number is measured on the pinned commits (the certificates and oracles offline, the agent runs on Token Factory) and names its source. The verdict and check rows, and the certificate line under a value of a row that names a certificate count, are read from the certificate files in this directory and in runs/immich-ladder/ when the page is built; a row whose numbers the gate measured differently says why in `differs`.

rows.source: docs/storyboard.md (lead table); docs/gates.md (G3 table); runs/immich-ladder/certificate.txt (K1, K2)
rows.differs: The gate counted moved and copied files with git's rename and copy detection at 50% similarity (spike/g3/measure-diff.mjs). The certifier pairs a head file with a base file only when their bytes are equal outside specifier spans, so a moved, copied or edited file with any other change is an added file to it, and only exact copies count as copies. The persistent branch's certified moves are its base files paired with their untouched copies in src.backup/ (the certificate's pathMap); the files it moved into src/features/ or edited are among the added.

rows.differs: The gate diffed each renamed or copied file against its original line by line. K2 compares only the files the certifier pairs with a base file, and those differ at most in specifier spans by construction, so the edits inside copies and rewrites are not K2's to see: those files are K1's added files, and K1 fails.
